hypothesis: Permitted state and frozen-prediction features can distinguish repair from damage better than species-only selection, without changing the correction itself.
evidence: correction-transfer frozen SmoothL1 repairs and damage
alternatives: Useful and harmful changes are not separable by an affine gate; fitting/calibration selection does not transfer; empirical safety removes all useful selections.
selection_rule: Seeded permutation of bound200k positions excluding first10k correction training and fixedU20k; first50k split20k/10k/20k. No development access. All species of each state stay in its role.
frozen_correction: Bound historical coordinate-sl110k head, weights and preprocessing verified by bindings; original continued GBCT base
features: Frozen119 prepared state/base features plus each output's correction coordinate and its absolute value. Correction coordinates divided by fitting-only RMS floored at1e-6. No reference features.
changed_factor: Species intercept-only versus species affine gate with7076 coefficients; same zero initialization, batches, BCE discordant-component objective and optimizer
fit: 2000updates,batch1000,freshAdam foreach=false,cosine1e-3 to1e-4,FP32 gate/FP64 BCE,mean over discordant components; no class balancing or checkpoint selection. Same-status components still included in final scoring.
selection_policy: Compare predicted probability of repair conditional on a pass-status change with one global threshold. Calibrate on fixed101 thresholds0..1 plus always-base1.01. Maximize calibration net passes subject to damage<=1%, nontrivial pass count and nontrivial sign errors no worse than base. Ties: fewer replacements then larger threshold. No statistical safety claim.
validity_guard: Before either gate can select correction, require initialY+correctedDelta>=0 for that component. This label-free endpoint constraint is declared for both arms; retain raw correction results and blocked counts. No clipping or conservation projection.
evaluation: Training-only check20k fixed before fitting; report full physical score, same-status tails, species/snapshot,repair/damage,signs,negative endpoints,mass/element residuals where matrix available. No full campaign qualification or latency claim.
advance_rule: Affine exceeds base and intercept by0.005 on check in both seeds, no nontrivial decline, damage<=0.02, no increased sign/negative counts, global/weakp99<=1.05. Then register full-U/D candidate. Otherwise reject this gate recipe and inspect discrimination before any related trial.
